_note: WT 3.0 locator cache. wt-member-web covers member site desktop (/web) and mobile-web (/mobile). One testID string resolves as data-testid on web, an unqualified resource-id on Android, and an accessibility id on iOS — a screen verified in one section seeds the others (see wt-app). wt-bo and wt-root-admin expose no data-testid attributes in the reference source; every locator there is role+name, CSS, or structural XPath.

wt-bo._noTestIds: Confirmed against the reference source: Back Office exposes no data-testid attributes. Every wt-bo locator is role+name, CSS, or attribute-based. Details: .claude/domain/wt-admin.md, .claude/platforms/bo.md.

wt-root-admin._noTestIds: Confirmed against the reference source: Root Admin exposes no data-testid attributes. Locators are structural XPath, e.g. the captcha field is //input[./following-sibling::div/img]. Details: .claude/domain/wt-admin.md, .claude/platforms/root-admin.md.

statement-patch-regeneration._notes: Root Admin > Troubleshoot Platform > tab 'Statement Patch & Regeneration'. No data-testid anywhere. Component library = Mantine; generated element ids are unstable, never target them. Dropdown options render as `span` inside a portal at body level, outside the tabpanel — use span:text-is() with exact text. Verified 2026-09-09 on SIT as user wt14266recon, tenant Centroid (centroid).

section1-select-client.heading: text=Select Client
section1-select-client._conditional: upload-csv-* and download-template-link render only when Statement Table != 'Executed Orders' (driven by Statement Table, NOT by tenant)

section2-data-query-patch._container: heading 'Statement Data Query & Patch' block; Occ>1 for 'Select Account ID' — this one is the FIRST occurrence on the page
section2-data-query-patch.heading: text=Statement Data Query & Patch
section2-data-query-patch._conditional: fetch-from-tenant-button appears only for Statement Table='Executed Orders'; search-button + export-data-button appear for the other 5

section3-preview-statement._container: heading 'Preview Statement' block; 'Select Account ID' here is the SECOND occurrence on the page
section3-preview-statement.heading: text=Preview Statement
section3-preview-statement._note: statement-type-mirror is permanently disabled; it follows section1 statement-type-input, cannot be set independently

section4-patch-history._container: heading 'Patch History' block; this is the SECOND table on the page
section4-patch-history.heading: text=Patch History
section4-patch-history.patched-dataset-link: table >> nth=1 >> tbody tr >> nth={i} >> td >> nth=2 >> a
section4-patch-history.action-failed-pill: table >> nth=1 >> tbody tr >> nth={i} >> td >> nth=8 >> p:text-is('FAILED')

role-management._notes: Root Admin > Role Management. Mantine. Privilege checkboxes are grouped under plain-text section labels (Client, Users, Roles, Company App Configs, Statistics Config (Volume Calculation), Troubleshoot Platform). Verified 2026-09-09 on SIT.

create-role-dialog.close: role=dialog[name='Create New User Role'] >> role=button >> nth=0
create-role-dialog.priv-view-patch-regenerate-statement-pag: role=checkbox[name='View Patch and Regenerate Statement Page']
create-role-dialog._disambiguation: 'Patch and Regenerate Statement' is a substring of 'View Patch and Regenerate Statement Page' — the exact-name match is mandatory or the locator resolves to 2 elements

user-management._notes: Verified 2026-09-09; re-verified 2026-09-10 creating wt14266exec. Only the `automation` account can reach this page. No per-user tenant/client field exists — Create and Edit dialogs carry Username, Display Name, Password, Roles only.

create-user-dialog.role-checkbox: role=checkbox[name='{role name}'] with exact:true — required, 'zz-wt14266-full' otherwise also matches 'zz-wt14266-viewonly'
create-user-dialog._hints: Username/Display Name placeholder 'Max 20 characters'; Password placeholder 'At least 12 alphanumeric characters required'
create-user-dialog.text-inputs: dialog >> input:not([type=checkbox]) — nth(0) Username, nth(1) Display Name, nth(2) Password (no name/aria/testid; getByLabel is unreliable here)
create-user-dialog.create-response: POST /api/root/management/v1/user → 200; toast 'User ({display name}) has been created'

user-management.table-row: role=row[name='{username}'] — cells: Username, Name, Roles, Status, Created, Actions
user-management.status-values: First Login (forced reset pending) → Active (after the user completes the reset)

login._notes: Structural only, no testids. Verified 2026-09-09 on SIT.
login.captcha-hint: text=Enter the 4 numbers displayed in the box
login.captcha-input: input >> nth=2 — the third input on the page. CSS input[type=text] does NOT match: Mantine omits the type attribute, so only the IDL property reads 'text'

first-login-password-reset._notes: Forced reset shown on a new user's first login. Verified 2026-09-10 with wt14266exec.
first-login-password-reset.url: lands on /root/dashboard with the reset modal over it
first-login-password-reset.heading: text=For better security, please reset password for first time login.
first-login-password-reset.response: PATCH /api/root/management/v1/user/password → 200, then redirects to the role's landing page
